title: turanga euphratica
intro: Turanga euphratica, commonly known as the Banyan fig tree, is a type of fig tree native to the Middle East. This deciduous tree has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, improve digestion, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Turanga euphratica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Turanga euphratica include its ability to calm the nervous system, improve immune function, and provide relief from pain and inflammation.
